correctness.rationale: A nontrivial 3-periodic state under the deterministic 0/1/2 Greenberg–Hastings rule must have all vertices cycling, because connectedness forbids a stationary zero neighbor to a cycling vertex. Each vertex must have a successor-color neighbor, a local condition on three consecutive rungs. The defined 81-state transfer T gives prism trace tr(T^n); rail swap J yields twisted trace tr(JT^n). Independently constructed both rational 45- and 36-dimensional symmetry blocks and symbolically confirmed the exact two factorized characteristic polynomials; Newton power sums then give P_n-M_n=2(1+(-1)^n)+4s_n with s_n=-5s_(n-2)+3s_(n-3). The dominant root alpha=(3+sqrt(17))/2 lies outside both cubic sectors, proving the strict relative exponential gap for all n. Independently enumerated all original 3^(2n) nonlinear initial states for n=3,4,5: (P,M)=(72,36),(252,48),(450,750), with successor criterion matched to direct three-step dynamics. These finite checks corroborate but do not replace the exact determinant argument.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General activity criteria apply to more graphs, but they do not count all initial states or determine a seam-specific signed recurrence. The exact free-ladder recurrence does not determine tr(T^n) or tr(JT^n).
